title: Canonical scheme pullback comparison for continuous-function set sheaves
statement: Use compatible universes [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $f:Y\to X$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] in universe $u$, and let $D$ be any topological space in universe $u+1$. Use the continuous-function set sheaves $F_{D,X}$ and $F_{D,Y}$ [def-sfb-continuous-set-sheaf] and the actual scheme inverse-image/direct-image adjunction $f^{-1}\dashv f_*$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Define $\rho_{f,D}:F_{D,X}\to f_*F_{D,Y}$ on every $V\to X$ by $s\mapsto s\circ|\operatorname{pr}_V|$, where $\operatorname{pr}_V:V\times_XY\to V$ is the first chosen fibre-product projection [def-pc-fibre-product]. Define $c_{f,D}:f^{-1}F_{D,X}\to F_{D,Y}$ to be the inverse adjunction-Hom-bijection image of $\rho_{f,D}$. These are specified canonical morphisms, with no invertibility assumption, and no compactness, separation, disconnectedness or discreteness assumption on $D$.
